+    def _print_Float(self, expr):
+        """Convert a Float to Mathematica format."""
+        # Get the float value
+        float_val = float(expr)
+        
+        # Format with scientific notation
+        sci_str = format(float_val, '.15e')
+        
+        # Parse the scientific notation
+        # Format is like "1.000000000000000e-04" or "1.500000000000000e+04"
+        match = re.match(r'([-+]?\d+\.\d+)e([+-])(\d+)', sci_str)
+        if not match:
+            # Fallback to simple replacement
+            return sci_str.replace('e', '*^')
+        
+        mantissa_str = match.group(1)
+        sign = match.group(2)
+        exp_str = match.group(3)
+        
+        # Clean up mantissa: remove trailing zeros but keep at least one decimal place
+        mantissa = float(mantissa_str)
+        # Format mantissa to remove trailing zeros
+        mantissa_formatted = "{:.15f}".format(mantissa).rstrip('0')
+        # Ensure at least one digit after decimal point
+        if mantissa_formatted.endswith('.'):
+            mantissa_formatted += '0'
+        
+        # Parse exponent as integer to remove leading zeros
+        exp_int = int(exp_str)
+        
+        # If exponent is 0, just return the mantissa
+        if exp_int == 0:
+            return mantissa_formatted
+        
+        # Build the result
+        if sign == '+':
+            result = "{}*^{}".format(mantissa_formatted, exp_int)
+        else:
+            result = "{}*^-{}".format(mantissa_formatted, exp_int)
+        
+        return result
